description: This Java class implements a JMS Queue message listener for the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages connection setup, message listening, and resource cleanup for a JMS queue, enabling asynchronous message processing within the application.

classes.name: JmsQueueListener
classes.description: A JMS queue message listener class that manages connection, session, and message consumption from a specified queue, integrated with the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: JmsQueueListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JMS listener with required parameters including JNDI context info and queue credentials.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes JMS session and connection, releasing resources.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Sets up JMS connection, session, and receiver, and starts listening to the specified queue.
